svg.aria-label: A dictionary entry turns a bit range into a named value
svg.title: A dictionary entry turns a bit range into a named value
svg.desc: The 23 bytes of a weather-station Observation message, 0200174b583700fb2e18bcda9b4236000004030201beef, with the bit range of each of its nine fields marked. A table gives the dictionary entry for each field (start bit, stop bit, type, options) and the value it decodes to: message_type Observation, message_length 23, station_id KX7, temperature -12.34, pressure 101325, wind_direction 271.5, humidity 45.5, sample_serial 16909060, checksum beef.
svg.text: A dictionary entry turns a bit range into a named value
Observation payload: 23 bytes in hex, with the start bit of each field above
